evidence: AdvisorConfigSlotLookup formats this string with an advisor token when its direct configuration lookup fails, then retries the lookup using the generated fallback key. The mapped bytes are the null-terminated ASCII string !%s.

interpretation: Maximum absolute heading adjustment angle
evidence: DirectionDrivenHeadingAngleStep clamps the entity's accumulated heading adjustment at this positive limit and at its negation; the mapped float value is 0.8 radians.

interpretation: Menu hover-status item index with -1 as the cleared sentinel
evidence: MenuHoverStatusTextDraw stores -1 here when the hover-status text is cleared and uses the current value to decide whether to update the menu's hover text; MenuTick participates in the same hover-status update path.

interpretation: Default scheduler value for AI_Priority_Ore
evidence: CmdRegistryInit initializes the AI priority value table at 0x004b32e8 to 49 and leaves this second entry at that default; CmdKindByName maps AI_Priority_Ore to index 1, and CmdSetKind reads this table entry when assigning the corresponding priority value to a command.

interpretation: Default scheduler value for AI_Priority_Construction
evidence: CmdRegistryInit initializes the AI priority value table at 0x004b32e8 to 49, then sets this fifth entry to 60; CmdKindByName maps AI_Priority_Construction to index 4, and CmdSetKind reads the table when assigning a command's priority value.

interpretation: Tooltip rendering viewport width
evidence: TooltipOverlayStateInitialize stores the display width returned by DisplayWidthGet here; TimedEffectSlotRender uses it to keep tooltip text within the right edge of the viewport.

interpretation: 125-second entity-update event countdown
evidence: EntityFrameUpdateDispatch subtracts frame time from this countdown and, on expiry, reloads it to 125 seconds and calls the event trigger with value 1.

interpretation: Maximum random Y-axis light drift offset
evidence: LightEffectsBlinkParametersApply stores the configured Y drift amplitude here; DriftOffsetStepApply samples a signed random value within this range and adds it to the light-effect Y offset.

interpretation: Maximum random Z-axis light drift offset
evidence: LightEffectsBlinkParametersApply stores the configured Z drift amplitude here; DriftOffsetStepApply samples a signed random value within this range and adds it to the light-effect Z offset.

interpretation: Remaining hold time for the configured random waypoint
evidence: RandomWaypointTimerStepApply decrements this timer during the hold phase, then advances the entity to the sampled waypoint when it expires; the configured range and movement phase are held in adjacent globals.

interpretation: Random jitter distance for the current jitter vector
evidence: JitterStepApply samples this distance from the configured range, scales a random unit vector by it, and uses the resulting vector to offset the target position; exact units depend on the caller's scene coordinates.

interpretation: First word of the current selection screen-coordinate pair
evidence: SelectionCoordinatesSet copies the first two words from its coordinate argument here and at 0x004ddd10; AdvisorOverlayUpdate and SimulationPointerActionDispatch use this pair for pointer hit-testing and overlay placement.

interpretation: Configured health-bar border size
evidence: HealthBarConfigLoadAndShadeDerive reads HealthBarBorderSize into this integer; RenderEntityScreenRing uses it to expand the health-bar rectangle and determine its border geometry.

interpretation: Advisor progress-bar fill image handle
evidence: PanelResourceLayoutStore creates the image handle here from the configured panel resource; AdvisorProgressBarFillDraw uses it to render a fill proportional to the supplied progress value.

interpretation: Configured down-arrow panel image handle
evidence: PanelRotationControlConfigLoad loads the DownImage resource into this handle; ManagerTick updates the corresponding panel control image when its state-change flag is set.

interpretation: Configured left-arrow panel image handle
evidence: PanelRotationControlConfigLoad loads the LeftImage resource into this handle; ManagerTick updates the corresponding panel control image when its state-change flag is set.

interpretation: Per-cursor flag selecting animated versus static cursor rendering
evidence: PointerCursorConfigLoad stores zero for a static surface and one for an animated FLIC cursor at each cursor index; PointerCursorDraw selects the corresponding rendering path using this flag.

interpretation: Base of the configured priority-image order list
evidence: PriorityImageOrderMoveToFront and UIListEntriesSwap exchange or shift entries between the lists at 0x00501118 and 0x0050111c, then update the associated AI priority value through PriorityEntryOrderValueSet; the parallel list at 0x0050111c tracks the displayed order.

interpretation: Base of the Direct3D render-state restore-pending flags
evidence: Direct3DRenderStateSetCached marks one flag at this base plus 8 bytes per render-state index and saves the prior state value in the adjacent word; D3DMaterialStateFlush restores marked values through the device and clears each flag.

interpretation: Saved Direct3D render-state value for state index 1
evidence: D3DRenderStateSync reads render state index 1 from the device into this value; Direct3DRenderStateRestore reinstates it if the cached current value at 0x00540574 changed.

interpretation: Saved Direct3D stage-0 state value
evidence: D3DRenderStateSync reads the stage-0 state into this value when the renderer path supports that state; Direct3DRenderStateRestore reinstates it when the cached current value at 0x00540578 differs.

interpretation: Cached current value for Direct3D render state index 1
evidence: D3DRenderStateSync initializes this cache from the saved value at 0x00540568; Direct3DDeviceStateApply updates it after successfully changing state index 1, and Direct3DRenderStateRestore compares it with the saved value.

interpretation: Cached current value for Direct3D stage-0 state
evidence: D3DRenderStateSync initializes this cache from the saved value at 0x0054056c; Direct3DDeviceStateApply updates it after successfully changing the stage-0 state, and Direct3DRenderStateRestore compares it with the saved value.

interpretation: Number of bits in the red channel pixel mask
evidence: SurfaceLockConfigurePixelWriter counts set bits in the red pixel mask and stores the count here; SurfaceColorPackToPixel uses it to scale the input red component when packing a color into the surface format.

interpretation: Number of bits in the green channel pixel mask
evidence: SurfaceLockConfigurePixelWriter counts set bits in the green pixel mask and stores the count here; SurfaceColorPackToPixel uses it to scale the input green component when packing a color into the surface format.

interpretation: Number of bits in the blue channel pixel mask
evidence: SurfaceLockConfigurePixelWriter counts set bits in the blue pixel mask and stores the count here; SurfaceColorPackToPixel uses it to scale the input blue component when packing a color into the surface format.

interpretation: Info-panel string-entry display and resource flags
evidence: InfoPanelStringEntriesInitialize stores the entry's base mode value here at a 0x20-byte stride and sets bit 2 when the associated image surface is present; other entry state bits are assigned by the initializer's mode argument.

interpretation: Height of the indexed terrain-surface grid
evidence: IndexedSurfaceResourceAllocate stores the grid height here; TerrainDirtyCellQuadNormalEmitPass iterates rows up to this value, and TerrainCellSurfaceNormalGet rejects row indices outside the height.

interpretation: Reward-screen display-enabled flag
evidence: RewardInit reads the Reward.Display option into this value and normalizes the disabled result; RewardSaveButtonZoneCheck only opens the save action when the flag is nonzero.

interpretation: Reward credits text X coordinate
evidence: RewardInit loads the first TextPos coordinate into this value; RewardDisplayTick uses it to center the reward credits text horizontally.

interpretation: Reward credits text Y coordinate
evidence: RewardInit loads the second TextPos coordinate into this value; RewardDisplayTick uses it as the vertical origin for the reward credits text.

interpretation: Owned loading-progress title string
evidence: KeyValueEqualsFileLoad duplicates this optional label and replaces underscores with spaces; FileLoadingProgressUpdate measures and draws the resulting text beside the progress display.

interpretation: Cached WAD mount-path prefix string
evidence: WadMountPathCacheStore copies a nonempty path of at most 1024 bytes into this buffer and sets the adjacent valid flag; MountedPathPrefixRewrite checks incoming paths against the cached prefix and rewrites matching paths using the cached mount path.

interpretation: Number of entries in the primary model-resource path cache
evidence: ModelResourceResolveOrLoad searches the primary path/handle table at 0x00540838 using this count, and ResourceStringTablesFree releases the owned path strings for the same number of entries.

interpretation: Number of entries in the secondary model-resource path cache
evidence: ModelResourceResolveOrLoad searches the secondary path/handle table at 0x00542778 using this count when the fallback resource prefix is enabled, and ResourceStringTablesFree releases the owned strings for these entries.

interpretation: Base of per-entry streamed-wave global memory buffers
evidence: SoundBankEntryRelease frees and clears this HGLOBAL at an 0x134-byte stride for the selected sound-bank entry; StreamedWaveBufferStepRate reads the buffer header's length when calculating playback progress.

interpretation: Optional front-light scene handle
evidence: SceneLightsBuildFromConfig creates this light from the configured front-light RGB value when the configuration key exists, enables the resulting handle, and skips it when the key is absent.

interpretation: Scene root for the cursor-following spotlight
evidence: SceneLightsBuildFromConfig creates this root scene object and attaches the white spotlight resource at 0x00556104; MainSimInteractionAndCellUpdate moves the root to the current terrain-pointer target.

interpretation: Configured TV clip distance used by sound updates
evidence: GameConfigInit reads the tvclipdist value into this float and applies it to both sound buffers; SoundMinimumDistanceUpdateMode restores this distance when switching out of the alternate audio mode.

interpretation: X coordinate of the current terrain-pointer target cell
evidence: MainSimInteractionAndCellUpdate stores the cell X coordinate here when a valid terrain command target is found and clears the target-valid flag at 0x00556188 when no cell is eligible.

interpretation: Y coordinate of the current terrain-pointer target cell
evidence: MainSimInteractionAndCellUpdate stores the cell Y coordinate here when a valid terrain command target is found and clears the target-valid flag at 0x00556188 when no cell is eligible.

interpretation: Valid-target flag for the terrain-pointer cell coordinates
evidence: MainSimInteractionAndCellUpdate sets this flag when the pointer resolves to an eligible terrain cell and stores that cell at 0x00556180 and 0x00556184; it clears the flag when the current hit is invalid.

interpretation: ObjectTheNames handle array for entity subtype 5
evidence: ObjectTheNamesLoad allocates this array using the subtype-5 count at 0x0055628c and loads localized ObjectTheNames handles using keys from 0x005561f8; LocalizedObjectTheNameGet indexes the array for that subtype.

interpretation: X coordinate of the camera's stored world-space focus point
evidence: OListEntityRecordParse stores the computed world X coordinate here when a camera-focus record has no attached entity; UpdateRenderViewportState uses this point when the attached object is absent, and SelectionObjectDetach saves the detached object's position here.

interpretation: Y coordinate of the camera's stored world-space focus point
evidence: OListEntityRecordParse stores the computed world Y coordinate here when a camera-focus record has no attached entity; UpdateRenderViewportState uses this point when the attached object is absent, and SelectionObjectDetach saves the detached object's position here.

interpretation: Current camera focus distance
evidence: GameConfigInit and OListEntityRecordParse initialize this value to 15; camera zoom input clamps it between 10 and 20, and UpdateRenderViewportState and the camera-target helpers use it when updating the viewport.

interpretation: First CRT signal-record slot reserved for floating-point exceptions
evidence: CrtSignalHandlerDispatch clears seven 12-byte exception-handler records beginning at this index in the shared table at 0x004b22b0; the static value is 3 and the table contains ten records total.

interpretation: Count of CRT floating-point exception-handler records to clear
evidence: CrtSignalHandlerDispatch clears this many 12-byte records beginning at slot 0x004b2320 when handling the floating-point exception signal; the initialized count is seven.

interpretation: Number of records in the CRT signal-handler table
evidence: CrtSignalHandlerRecordFind scans the 12-byte signal-handler table beginning at 0x004b22a8 up to this record count; the initialized table has ten entries.

interpretation: Pending CRT floating-point exception subcode
evidence: CrtSignalHandlerDispatch temporarily saves and replaces this code while invoking the registered handler for signal 8, then restores the saved value; the initialized floating-point exception code is 0x8C.

interpretation: Pointer to the CRT standard-timezone name buffer
evidence: CrtTimeZoneStateInit copies the system standard-timezone name or the POSIX TZ abbreviation into this pointed-to buffer and terminates it; the pointer initially targets the 64-byte buffer at 0x004b2900.

interpretation: Pointer to the CRT daylight-timezone name buffer
evidence: CrtTimeZoneStateInit copies the system daylight-timezone name or the parsed daylight abbreviation into this pointed-to buffer and terminates it; the pointer initially targets the 64-byte buffer at 0x004b2940.

interpretation: Year cached for the daylight-saving start transition
evidence: CrtDaylightTransitionBoundaryCompute stores the year when it computes the start boundary; CrtDaylightSavingTimeCheck uses it to avoid recomputing the transition for the same year.

interpretation: Year cached for the daylight-saving end transition
evidence: CrtDaylightTransitionBoundaryCompute stores the year when it computes the end boundary; CrtDaylightSavingTimeCheck uses it to avoid recomputing the transition for the same year.

interpretation: Count of scalar envelope values parsed from the current LightWave scene
evidence: LoadLWSCScene stores parsed scalar envelope values in the table beginning at 0x005446c4 using this index and increments it for each value; the value-to-channel association is not retained in the current pseudocode path.

interpretation: First CD audio track number
evidence: GameConfigInit reads CDStartTrack into this value and defaults it to track 2; CDAudioWatchdogModeUpdate starts a track within the configured range.

interpretation: Number of CD audio tracks available to the watchdog
evidence: GameConfigInit reads CDTracks into this value, defaults it to one, and disables the music-on flag when the setting is absent; CDAudioWatchdogModeUpdate uses it to choose the track cycling range.

interpretation: Current input-state byte for selected-object state bit 1
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch detects a change from the prior byte at 0x0076aa08 and toggles bit 1 in the selected object or entity's state word when that selection type supports the bit. The physical key mapping is not identified here.

interpretation: Current input-state byte for selected-object state bit 0
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch detects a change from the prior byte at 0x0076aa09 and toggles bit 0 in the selected object or entity's state word when that selection type supports the bit. The physical key mapping is not identified here.

interpretation: Current input-state byte used for reward-screen advance and scroll reset
evidence: RewardScreenTransitionTick detects a press edge against the previous state at 0x0076aa13 to trigger the reward transition; RewardScrollTickerAdvanceAndDraw uses the held state to reset the ticker to its starting position. The physical key mapping is not identified here.

interpretation: Value bound to the pause and options menu trees
evidence: LoadMenuBuild passes this address as the value binding for both the PausedMenu and OptionsMenu definitions; OptionsLoadOrDefault resets it to zero when initializing menu state. Its specific menu label is not resolved from these callers.

interpretation: Pointer to the CRT numeric-string conversion result record
evidence: ParseEntityHealthValue writes conversion flags, consumed-character count, and a 64-bit parsed value into the shared record addressed by this pointer; the record begins at 0x00549138.

interpretation: Pointer to the CRT null-string formatting fallback
evidence: EngineFormatStringToStream substitutes the string addressed here when a %s or %Z argument is null; the pointer targets the runtime's fallback C string.

interpretation: Low word of the CRT positive-infinity double constant
evidence: CrtDoubleToIntegerRound combines this word with 0x004b224c to construct the IEEE-754 positive-infinity value used by its out-of-range conversion path.

interpretation: High word of the CRT positive-infinity double constant
evidence: CrtDoubleToIntegerRound combines this word with 0x004b2248 to construct the IEEE-754 positive-infinity value used by its out-of-range conversion path.

interpretation: Low word of the CRT maximum-finite-double constant
evidence: CrtDoubleToIntegerRound combines this word with 0x004b225c to construct the largest finite positive IEEE-754 double used by its saturation path.

interpretation: High word of the CRT maximum-finite-double constant
evidence: CrtDoubleToIntegerRound combines this word with 0x004b2258 to construct the largest finite positive IEEE-754 double used by its saturation path.

interpretation: Saved 64-bit x87 result for CRT floating-point exception handling
evidence: CrtFloatingPointExceptionResultDispatch and its variant store the current x87 value as a double starting here, then inspect its exponent bits to distinguish subnormal, overflow, and other exception cases.

interpretation: Base of DirectDraw display-mode records
evidence: DirectDrawDeviceInitialize and DisplayResolutionComboPopulate enumerate display-mode records from this base at 0x114-byte strides; the selected record pointer is stored at 0x00568050 and used to create the display surface.

interpretation: Cached user32 MessageBoxA procedure address
evidence: CrtRuntimeErrorMessageBoxDisplay resolves MessageBoxA from user32.dll into this slot on first use and calls it for later runtime error dialogs.

interpretation: Cached user32 GetActiveWindow procedure address
evidence: CrtRuntimeErrorMessageBoxDisplay resolves GetActiveWindow from user32.dll into this slot and uses it to choose the owner window for runtime error dialogs.

interpretation: Cached user32 GetLastActivePopup procedure address
evidence: CrtRuntimeErrorMessageBoxDisplay resolves GetLastActivePopup from user32.dll into this slot and uses it to choose the active popup owner for runtime error dialogs.

interpretation: Integer format string %i for status and pair counts
evidence: The executable stores the null-terminated bytes %i here; InfoMessageQueueTick, EntityPairCountRefresh, and PairCountHistogramBuild use it to format integer counts.

interpretation: Base of previous input-state bytes used by selected-object flag toggles
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch compares the byte fields at offsets +2 and +3 here, and the adjacent bytes at 0x0076aa08 and 0x0076aa09, against current input state before toggling selected-object bits 3 through 0.

interpretation: Current input-state byte for debug action 5 and edit-mode gating
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch dispatches debug action 5 on a press edge against 0x0076aa0e; EnginePreTick also checks this state while handling typed input for the active debug label. The physical key mapping is not identified here.

interpretation: Current input-state byte for a mode-dependent action
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch detects a press edge against 0x0076aa16 and calls one of two mode-dependent helpers; the selected helper depends on the state at 0x0076abaa. The physical key mapping and action name are unresolved.

interpretation: Input-state gate for simulation debug controls
evidence: MainSimStep processes several debug-monitor and overlay controls only while this byte is nonzero, including controls at 0x0076aba1 and 0x0076aba2.

interpretation: Current input-state byte for a selected-entity debug action
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch detects a press edge against 0x0076aa1e and dispatches selected-entity actions through helpers at 0x0040f330, 0x00444620, or 0x00402e40 depending on the active mode. The physical key mapping is not identified here.

interpretation: Current input-state byte for applying a repeated selected-object action
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch detects a press edge against 0x0076aa21 and applies the action through FUN_0043f6a0 to each selected object; MainSimStep also checks this byte with the simulation debug controls.

interpretation: Current input-state byte for selected-cell and terrain actions
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch detects a press edge against 0x0076aa23, calls FUN_00466250, and clears selected Type4 cell state when applicable. The physical key mapping is not identified here.

interpretation: Current input-state byte dispatching a selected-object helper
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch detects a press edge against 0x0076aa2e and calls FUN_004487c0 for the current selection. The helper's exact action and physical key mapping are unresolved.

interpretation: Advisor action mode or orientation field in the 0x24-byte slot record
evidence: AdvisorPositionRecordInitialize and AdvisorActionPositionAndModeSet store the action mode here; AdvisorApplySlotTransform passes it to the transform helper unless the slot's fixed-position flag is set.

interpretation: Advisor action X offset
evidence: AdvisorPositionRecordInitialize and AdvisorActionPositionAndModeSet store the action's horizontal offset here; AdvisorApplySlotTransform adds it to the computed motion offset before positioning the advisor scene object.

interpretation: Advisor action Y offset
evidence: AdvisorPositionRecordInitialize and AdvisorActionPositionAndModeSet store the action's vertical offset here; AdvisorApplySlotTransform adds it to the computed motion offset before positioning the advisor scene object.

interpretation: Base of the 20-entry flagged-object screen-ring timer registry
evidence: FlaggedObjectTimerRegistryInsert adds eligible flagged entities with a 37.5-second timer in the second word of each eight-byte slot; TickEntityScreenEffects draws a screen ring while the timer is active, decrements it, and removes the entry at expiry. EntityPointerRegistriesRemove clears entries when an entity is destroyed.

interpretation: Base of the 20-entry Type2 idle-object timer registry
evidence: IdleQueueRegister stores Type2 entities here with a 12.5-second timer in the second word of each eight-byte slot; TickEntityScreenEffects updates the idle-target visual and decrements the timer until the slot expires. EntityPointerRegistriesRemove clears entries for destroyed entities.

interpretation: One-past-end address of the 50-entry Type2 screen-effect registry
evidence: EntityPointerRegistriesRemove, Type2TimedRegistryInsert, and TickEntityScreenEffects use this address as the loop bound for the eight-byte records beginning at 0x00557bc4; it marks the end of the 50-slot table.

interpretation: Base of 2000 map-file resource handle slots
evidence: MapFileResourceSlotAllocate finds a free slot and stores its allocated resource buffer at this base plus eight bytes per slot; MapFileResourceSlotGet returns active handles and MapFileResourceSlotRelease frees and clears them.

interpretation: Base of per-slot allocation flags for the 2,000 map-file resource slots
evidence: MapFileResourceSlotsReset clears each eight-byte slot's flag and data; MapFileResourceSlotAllocate finds a slot whose low allocation bit is clear and sets it; MapFileResourceSlotGet checks the flag before returning a handle, and MapFileResourceSlotRelease clears it after freeing the associated buffer

interpretation: CRT file-open mode string wb
evidence: The executable stores the null-terminated bytes wb here; SavWriteSlot, OsfWrite, and BitmapFileWrite pass this mode to the CRT file opener when creating binary output files.

interpretation: Integer format string %d used for reward and counter text
evidence: The executable stores the null-terminated bytes %d here; RewardStatsTextFormat and CounterFormatStringBuild use it to format integer values.

interpretation: Win32 application instance handle
evidence: WinMain stores its HINSTANCE argument here; DirectInputInitialize passes it to DirectInputCreateA, and the options dialog path uses it as the dialog resource instance.

interpretation: Main game window HWND
evidence: WindowStateInitialize stores the window handle here; DirectDrawClipperSetRegion, WindowedRenderSurfaceBlit, and cursor-coordinate conversion pass it to Win32 window APIs.

interpretation: DirectDraw renderer fullscreen-mode flag
evidence: DirectDrawRendererInit stores its mode argument here; RenderSurfacePresent and RenderSurfaceRestoreFromPrimary select the flip/fullscreen path when it is nonzero, while a zero value selects the windowed blit path.

interpretation: Saved Direct3D render-state value used to trigger a state restore
evidence: D3DRenderStateSync copies the device state at 0x00540564 here on one path; Direct3DRenderStateRestore checks this value and, when nonzero, calls FUN_004788d0(1) before clearing it. The exact state meaning is not established.

interpretation: CRT signal-dispatch saved or active signal state
evidence: CrtSignalHandlerDispatch saves this value before special handling for signals 8, 11, and 4, temporarily clears it, and restores a selected value before returning; its exact reentrancy semantics remain unclear.

interpretation: Buffer holding the executable module path for CRT command-line initialization
evidence: CrtCommandLineArgumentsInit passes this 260-byte buffer to GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, ..., 0x104) and uses it as the fallback argv[0] path.

interpretation: First copied CRT code-page metadata word
evidence: CrtLocaleCodePageTableUpdate copies this word from the selected 12-byte static code-page record and clears it when using the Windows GetCPInfo fallback; the field meaning is unresolved.

interpretation: Second copied CRT code-page metadata word
evidence: CrtLocaleCodePageTableUpdate copies this word from the selected 12-byte static code-page record and clears it when using the Windows GetCPInfo fallback; the field meaning is unresolved.

interpretation: Third copied CRT code-page metadata word
evidence: CrtLocaleCodePageTableUpdate copies this word from the selected 12-byte static code-page record and clears it when using the Windows GetCPInfo fallback; the field meaning is unresolved.

interpretation: High-water mark for the accumulated UI sample count
evidence: CommandSampleStatsAccumulate adds each sample record’s value at offset +4 to the per-entry total at 0x0054c268 and stores the maximum observed total here; UiTextEntryLoad resets it. Per-entry records have stride 0x27c.

interpretation: Scene-object handle for the file-loading progress indicator
evidence: KeyValueEqualsFileLoad creates this handle from its progress-scene argument, and FileLoadingProgressUpdate moves or updates the referenced scene object while loading.

interpretation: Secondary scene object created during game configuration initialization
evidence: GameConfigInit creates this with fixed arguments (0x10, 0x0d, 0x97, 0x97) under the scene object at 0x005560e8 and later applies TVClipDist to it; its specific visual role is unresolved.

interpretation: First float of the cached three-dimensional selection point
evidence: MainSimInteractionAndCellUpdate writes this and the adjacent floats at 0x00556168 and 0x0055616c as a point; SelectionRectangleRender passes the three-float vector to the camera projection helper before drawing the rectangle.

interpretation: Configured HPBlocks value used by scene-marker health display
evidence: GameConfigInit loads the integer HPBlocks setting here, and SceneMarkerUpdateAndDraw passes it as the display scaling/range value when drawing the scene marker.

interpretation: First argument of the pending interface spawn request
evidence: InterfaceSpawnRequestEnqueue stores its first argument here alongside the second argument at 0x00556444; MainSimInteractionAndCellUpdate later passes the pair to the placement/route command helper.

interpretation: Second argument of the pending interface spawn request
evidence: InterfaceSpawnRequestEnqueue stores its second argument here alongside the first argument at 0x00556440; MainSimInteractionAndCellUpdate later passes the pair to the placement/route command helper.

interpretation: Configured MinEnergyForEat threshold
evidence: GameConfigInit reads MinEnergyForEat into this float. PlaceCommandEligibilityCheck and EntityEnergyLowTargetRouteCommandTick compare an entity’s stored energy percentage against its maximum energy multiplied by this percentage threshold.

interpretation: Number of enumerated DirectDraw display-mode records
evidence: DirectDrawDeviceInitialize passes this count to DirectDrawEnumerateAndStoreCallbackResult, then iterates the records from 0 through count minus one when trying available display modes.

interpretation: Base of the enumerated DirectDraw display-mode record table
evidence: DirectDrawDeviceInitialize passes this address as the display-mode output table; each record is 0x114 bytes and the count is stored at 0x005580a0.

interpretation: DirectDraw interface pointer output by enumerated-device creation
evidence: DirectDrawEnumeratedDeviceCreate clears this field before creating a DirectDraw interface and returns its value through the caller’s output pointer; the exact callback write path is indirect.

interpretation: Width of the windowed DirectDraw render surface
evidence: DirectDrawRendererInit stores its selected render width here, and WindowedRenderSurfaceBlit uses it as the right edge of the source rectangle.

interpretation: Height of the windowed DirectDraw render surface
evidence: DirectDrawRendererInit stores its selected render height here, and WindowedRenderSurfaceBlit uses it as the bottom edge of the source rectangle.

interpretation: Packed RGB color used for renderer fog
evidence: RendererFogColorSet packs the configured red, green, and blue components into this value and sends it to the scene interface; RendererFogEnableAndColorApply reuses the stored packed color.

interpretation: Current file cursor position for a streamed audio resource
evidence: SoundBankEntryLoad stores the value returned by the CRT file-position helper here in each 0x134-byte audio record. StreamedWaveBufferStepRate divides it by the loaded file size for streamed files or by the stream buffer position for the other path.

interpretation: Base of the primary model-resource path and handle cache
evidence: ModelResourceResolveOrLoad performs a case-insensitive path lookup here using the entry count at 0x005446bc, then appends path/handle pairs on a successful load. ResourceStringTablesFree releases the owned path strings; each pair has an 8-byte stride.

interpretation: Base of the secondary model-resource path and handle cache
evidence: ModelResourceResolveOrLoad searches this case-insensitive path/handle table when the fallback resource prefix is enabled, using the entry count at 0x005446c0. ResourceStringTablesFree releases the owned path strings; each pair has an 8-byte stride.

interpretation: Shared pause/options menu state field, initialized to one
evidence: LoadMenuBuild passes this field by address into both the paused-menu and options-menu constructors and initializes it to one; the field is consumed by menu callbacks, but its user-facing meaning is not resolved.

interpretation: Start of the runtime directory-token path list
evidence: FileTokenListLoadAndTreeScan copies each discovered path into this buffer at 0x400-byte intervals, and DirectoryTokenListCompare scans the entries case-insensitively using the count at 0x0076a9e0.

interpretation: Previous-frame state byte for the debug cell-mutation input
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch compares the current input byte at 0x0076ab91 with this saved byte to detect a new press before applying the debug cell mutation.

interpretation: Previous-frame snapshot byte for an input state
evidence: MainSimStep compares this byte with the current input state at 0x0076ab9f to detect transitions that trigger input actions; the physical key or control mapped to this slot is unresolved.

interpretation: Previous-frame state byte for the debug input at 0x0076abac
evidence: MainSimStep compares this saved byte with the current state at 0x0076abac before running the associated debug-only action.

interpretation: Pending middle-mouse double-click event flag
evidence: GameWindowProcedure and MainWindowActivationAndCloseHandler set this flag for window message 0x0206, and WinMain clears it while preparing the per-frame input state.

interpretation: Current debug cell-mutation input state byte
evidence: LevelDebugInputCellMutatorDispatch runs the debug cell mutation path while this byte is active and compares it with the previous-frame byte at 0x0076aa11 to detect a new press.

interpretation: Current state byte for a debug-only input control
evidence: MainSimStep checks this byte when debug keys are enabled and compares it with the previous-frame snapshot at 0x0076aa2c before running an entity debug action; the specific control is unresolved.

interpretation: Default file extension for ACT frame resources
evidence: EntityVisualTypeTablesInit initializes this extension pointer to the static string "x"; EntityVisualLoadACT and DDiSceneActFrameRecordParse format ACT frame resource paths with this configured extension.

interpretation: Green component of the selection rectangle color
evidence: GameConfigInit defaults the DragBoxRGB channels here and at 0x00556f2c and 0x00556f34; a configured DragBoxRGB triplet replaces the defaults, and SelectionRectangleRender passes the three normalized components to the rectangle renderer.

interpretation: Blue component of the selection rectangle color
evidence: GameConfigInit defaults the DragBoxRGB channels here and at 0x00556f2c and 0x00556f30; a configured DragBoxRGB triplet replaces the defaults, and SelectionRectangleRender passes the three normalized components to the rectangle renderer.

interpretation: Configuration handle for the CreditsTextFile menu entry
evidence: GameConfigInit reads CreditsTextFile from Lego.cfg into this handle, and MainMenuTextItem passes it to the credits text-loading helper.

interpretation: Configuration handle for the CreditsBackAVI menu entry
evidence: GameConfigInit reads CreditsBackAVI from Lego.cfg into this handle, and MainMenuTextItem passes it to the credits background animation loader.

interpretation: Green component of the configured FogColourRGB value
evidence: LevelLoad reads the FogColourRGB triplet into 0x0055640c, this value, and 0x00556414; it passes all three components to RendererFogColorSet.
